consensus_summary: Marriage and the bride symbolize the covenant union between God (or Christ) and His people (or the Church).
book_summary: Marriage symbolizes the covenant union of God and His people, characterized as a one-flesh bond involving the Husband's covering and name.
consensus_core_identification: Covenant union between God/Christ and His people/the Church.
book_core_identification: The covenant union of God and His people.
rationale: Both the consensus and the book identify marriage and the bride as the covenant union between God/Christ and His people. The book's mention of a one-flesh bond and covering are descriptive details that align seamlessly with the consensus.
